text: Sudden, violent onset after exposure to dry cold wind or fright. Great fear, anxiety and restlessness; fear of death, predicts the time. High fever with dry hot skin, unquenchable thirst for cold water. Complaints worse around midnight, worse in a warm room. Useful in the very first stage of acute inflammatory and febrile states.

Sudden high fever with red, hot, flushed face and radiating heat. Throbbing, pulsating headache worse from light, noise, jarring and lying down. Dilated pupils, delirium. Right-sided complaints. Worse afternoon (3 pm) and touch; better semi-erect. Acute congestive, inflammatory conditions.

Great anguish, restlessness and anxiety with prostration out of proportion to the illness. Fastidious, chilly, fears death and being alone. Burning pains paradoxically better from heat/warm drinks. Thirst for small sips often. Symptoms worse after midnight (1-2 am). Gastroenteritis, food poisoning, exhaustion.

Irritable, impatient, oversensitive, ambitious workaholic. Digestive complaints from overindulgence in food, coffee, alcohol, stimulants. Ineffectual urging for stool, cramping. Chilly, worse morning, cold, mental exertion; better warmth and short sleep. The great remedy of modern sedentary, stressed life.

Mild, yielding, weepy, affectionate; craves consolation and open air. Changeable, shifting symptoms and moods. Thick, bland, yellow-green discharges. Thirstless even with fever. Worse warm stuffy room, evening, rich fatty food; better cool open air and gentle motion. Suited to gentle, tearful temperaments.

Complaints worse from the slightest motion; wants to keep perfectly still. Dryness of mucous membranes, great thirst for large quantities at long intervals. Irritable, wants to be left alone; talks of business. Stitching, tearing pains. Better firm pressure and rest. Respiratory and rheumatic complaints.

Restless; complaints worse on first motion and better from continued motion (rusty-gate). Worse cold damp weather, rest, night; better warmth, movement, dry weather. Stiffness of joints and muscles relieved by limbering up. Great restlessness, must constantly change position. Sprains, rheumatism, influenza.

Hot, untidy, philosophical; burning sensations on vertex, soles, orifices which are red. Worse warmth of bed, 11 am hunger, standing, washing. Offensive discharges. Skin complaints, itching worse from heat and scratching. Frequently indicated to complete a case that relapses or fails to improve.

Lack of self-confidence with anticipatory anxiety, yet domineering at home. Right-sided complaints, often moving right to left. Digestive weakness with bloating, flatulence, early satiety; craves sweets and warm drinks. Worse 4-8 pm. Liver and urinary affinity.

Extreme irritability and oversensitivity to pain; capricious, wants things then rejects them. Child quiet only when carried. Teething troubles, one cheek red one pale, greenish diarrhoea. Worse night, heat, anger, 9 pm; better being carried. Colic and dentition of children.

Dullness, drowsiness, dizziness, trembling. Anticipatory anxiety before ordeals with diarrhoea. Heaviness of eyelids and limbs; wants to be held still. Thirstless. Slow-onset influenza with aching, chills up and down the spine. Worse anticipation, damp weather; better profuse urination.

Effects of acute grief, disappointment, suppressed emotion. Sighing, sobbing, contradictory and changeable symptoms. Sensation of a lump in the throat. Worse from emotions, coffee, consolation; better distraction. The premier acute remedy for recent grief and hysterical states.
